phases.name: Slice 01: Inbox button, screen, and one message per matchday with title and score line (DD9 commit 3)

criteria: The club home offers a sixth button named Inbox, 44px or taller, after Table, from the club pick, after matchday 14 and after Continue; the other five keep their order and names

matchdayReports gives, per matchday the club played, the club's Pos in the standings over results up to that matchday (position is in the type and function now; the position line is rendered in the next step); it matches the independent oracle over seeds 1..300 x 8 clubs x 14 matchdays and the pinned DISCUSS goldens, and rejects invalid logs with RangeError

ViewInbox is valid from a known club's club home only (else a no-op); opening the Inbox and going back change nothing in formation, xi, results or the saved text; tactics changes never change a message; no save-format change and no SAVE_VERSION bump

The three scaffolds (matchdayReports, viewInbox, inboxOf) are replaced and no __SCAFFOLD__ marker remains in src/; the 8-file D8 amend patch is applied in this commit (each five-button list becomes six, replaced never weakened) and the amended specs pass

steps.implementation_notes: TEST PARADIGM: TypeScript project, so property tests use fast-check (honour FC_SEED) where the contract is a property (held-out files already carry them: time-travel numRuns 100, readonly 40 actions); goldens are pinned from DISCUSS in inbox-reference.ts, never re-pinned from DELIVER output. Mechanics: from docs/feature/S-011/distill/pending/, git mv each acceptance .pending file (drop the suffix) into tests/acceptance/S-011/ in this commit, confirm RED against the scaffolds, then GREEN; git apply pending/amend-existing-tests.patch in this same commit; never edit an assertion to fit the implementation; then grep the amended files for leftover 'five' wording. Do NOT move the e2e spec yet (step 03-01). Contract shapes: matchdayReports and inboxOf pure-function (return-only, frozen inputs unchanged); update is bounded-change, universe { league, screen, formation, xi?, results? }, delta 'screen' only, GameState keeps its five keys; renderInbox is bounded-change and emits only Back (dispatch narrowed to Back at compile time; one dispatch, one addEventListener, no .focus(, no innerHTML). Domain: split matchdayReports into small functions (prefix filter, own entry, one report), complexity 8 or less; position = club row of standings over entries with matchday <= N (use <=, newest first); the Table's order is never copied. update: one HANDLERS entry viewInbox, 'inbox' in HOME_RETURNING_KINDS, sameScreen default and focusPlan unchanged. Markup (DD5): section.inbox > h1 tabindex=-1, optional p.inbox-empty, ul role=list aria-label=Messages class=message-list (always rendered), button.back-button; li.message holds p.message-title (matchdayTitle) and the shared scoreLine; titles are p not h2; the p.message-position line is NOT rendered in this step. CSS: .message .score-line override sets no display, float, position, text-transform or content; overflow-wrap anywhere; 48px buttons. Add the inbox entry to RENDERERS with an inboxOrThrow. Tests delete docs/feature/S-011/distill/pending/ files as they move; the full directory goes in step 03-01. Trim lever: if the 1200-line checkpoint trips, merge grep tests into one file then fold the names check into the source file.

?seed=abc and no seed give the same Inbox (Oakhampton Rise Borough: Matchday 1, Harrowgate Lane United 0–1 Oakhampton Rise Borough, League position 3rd); tactics, reload and Continue never change a message; opening the Inbox writes no save
